articles.title: FACT CHECK: Is the Centre planning to blend ethanol in aviation fuel?
articles.description: A controversy has erupted over alleged plans to blend ethanol into Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF), following the E20 petrol rollout. While AAP convener Arvind Kejriwal raised concerns about flight safety, Union Civil Aviation Minister K Ram Mohan Naidu dismissed these claims as false and irresponsible, emphasizing passenger safety and the absence of any proposal for ethanol blending in ATF. The minister also clarified the distinction between regular ATF and Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), a renewable alternative that India aims to incorporate into its aviation fuel mix with specific blending targets for international flights.
